---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill when building or editing web pages for Persisstant, a student personal assistant startup.
---

1. Brand name is always "Persisstant", spelled P-e-r-s-i-s-s-t-a-n-t. Tagline: "Someone looking out for you."
2. Tone: warm, welcoming, slightly motherly, like a caring elder sister. Encouraging and responsible, never judgmental or robotic.
3. Colours: background cream #FAF6F0, cards oat #EFE8DC, text and buttons deep forest green #1B3B2B, accents sage #4A7C59.
4. Fonts: Fraunces (serif, bold) for headlines; Plus Jakarta Sans (regular/medium) for body text and buttons.
5. Every page includes a privacy and encryption badge explaining that email and chat access is opt-in, plus a waitlist or sign-up call to action.
6. Every page features concrete student examples: exam study reminders, nudges to check in on loved ones, and weekly or semester prep previews.
7. Prices are whole dollars without cents ($5/month, Free). Dates use Month Day format (October 14). Counts use numerals (3 exams, 2 messages).
8. Cards have 16px rounded corners and buttons are fully rounded (9999px), with soft natural shadows.
9. Pages must look good on a phone first, and each page is a single HTML file with its CSS inside it.
10. Never use guilt-inducing urgency, countdown timers, red warning badges, or surveillance-style words like "tracking" or "monitoring".
